description: Application bundle: read the documents we need to write and submit the applications, with the account ID and the access token. For each clinician whose documents you send: the state license, malpractice certificate, W-9 and CV with work history, a DEA registration for prescribers, and board certification if certified; for each clinician whose documents come from CAQH, or whose payer works from the CAQH profile: the CAQH ID and access for Licium; and once for the group, the IRS letter with its Tax ID. Each document has its status (needed, received, accepted, or needs_resend with the reason) and the type and size of what was sent. The list opens when payment settles.

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.
